title: When Does Pre-Trained Capacity Help Causal Learning? From Scalar Prediction to Counterfactual Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.33311v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How does pre-trained model capacity relate to performance after adaptation for causal tasks? We study two systems built on the Qwen 2.5 family: CausalLLM, which estimates scalar potential outcomes with treatment-specific heads, and CausalGen, which generates treatment-conditioned text or code using soft prefixes and factual supervised fine-tuning (SFT), counterfactual SFT, and preference alignment. Increasing backbone size from 0.5B to 1.5B yields mixed scalar-estimation results on IHDP, but improves CodeGen pass@1 from 0.267 to 0.575 and treatment-effect score from 0.231 to 0.515 after the complete generative pipeline. Within 0.5B CausalLLM, narrative inputs reduce mean sqrt(PEHE) from 1.842 to 1.780, a 3.4% improvement over tabular inputs; the 5.8% improvement over a no-LLM baseline combines changes in representation and input format. These descriptive comparisons motivate a distinction between available and convertible capacity. The

translated_title: 预训练容量何时有助于因果学习？从标量预测到反事实后训练
translated_abstract: 预训练模型容量与因果任务适配后的性能之间有何关系？我们研究了基于 Qwen 2.5 家族构建的两个系统：CausalLLM 使用针对处理（treatment）特定的输出头来估计标量潜在结果，CausalGen 则使用软前缀、事实监督微调（SFT）、反事实 SFT 以及偏好对齐来生成以处理为条件的文本或代码。将骨干网络规模从 0.5B 增加到 1.5B，在 IHDP 数据集上的标量估计结果好坏参半，但在完整的生成式流程之后，CodeGen pass@1 从 0.267 提升到 0.575，处理效应分数从 0.231 提升到 0.515。在 0.5B 的 CausalLLM 中，叙事输入将平均 sqrt(PEHE) 从 1.842 降低到 1.780，相比表格输入有 3.4% 的改进；相比无 LLM 基线的 5.8% 改进则结合了表示方式和输入格式两方面的变化。这些描述性比较引出了“可用容量”与“可转换容量”之间的区别。
tldr: 预训练容量对因果学习的帮助取决于后训练的转换方式：增大模型规模对生成式反事实任务提升显著（CodeGen pass@1 从 0.267 升至 0.575），对标量潜在结果估计的改进则有限，因此应区分“可用容量”与“可转换容量”。
en_tdlr: Pre-trained model capacity helps causal learning more when converted through generative post-training pipelines (e.g., CodeGen pass@1 rising from 0.267 to 0.575) than through scalar potential-outcome estimation, motivating a distinction between available and convertible capacity.
